rejected_draft.email:
Subject: Your hiring pace vs. peer companies

TD Bank posted 370 roles in the last 30 days—about 18.5x the median pace I track across similar companies. I built a daily ingestion from career boards into a warehouse with dbt models and a per-technology demand index to surface this kind of signal https://zohaiba365.github.io/Signal/companies/td-bank/ 

One pattern I'm noticing: TD Bank mentions Power BI in ~10% of postings, about 5.7x the peer rate. Does that reflect a real shift in your analytics stack, or an artifact of how roles are written?

I'm a Management Engineering student at Waterloo looking for Winter 2027 data engineering experience. Curious whether TD Bank has interest there.
rejected_draft.connection: I track hiring signals across tech stacks—TD Bank's posting pace is 18.5x the median, with Power BI in 5.7x the usual share of roles. I built a daily career board ingestion with a demand index: https://zohaiba365.github.io/Signal/companies/td-bank/ Does the Power BI concentration match your actual tech direction?

I'm still curious whether that reflects infrastructure decisions at TD Bank or just how roles get described. If you have a moment, your read would be really useful for the data I'm tracking.

I'm available for a brief call if there's a data engineering opportunity worth discussing for Winter 2027.

rejected_draft.email:
Subject: RBC's Tableau hiring spike

RBC posted all 111 of your open roles in the last 30 days—5.5x the median pace I track across companies. You're emphasizing Tableau in 24% of postings, 12.1x the peer average.

I built a warehouse ingesting daily from career boards, with dbt models and a per-technology demand index. You can see RBC's hiring patterns here: https://zohaiba365.github.io/Signal/companies/rbc/ 

Does this match what you're actually prioritizing for 2027—or does the Tableau emphasis understate the shift? I'm a Management Engineering student at Waterloo looking for a Winter 2027 Data Engineer term, and I'm curious whether this volume reflects new initiatives.
